subject: Re: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status - Cerulean Medical
messages:
From: Andrew Li <andrew.li@ceruleanmed.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@ceruleanmed.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Cerulean Medical is interested in Redwood for a pilot, but procurement and our security team need to validate several items before we can move forward. Can you confirm the following and share evidence where possible: 

- SOC 2 status and most recent report or summary
- SSO: support for SAML/Okta and any implementation guide
- SCIM provisioning: supported attributes and SCIM endpoint details
- RBAC and admin controls: screenshots or docs showing role definitions and admin workflows
- Any data residency/retention notes relevant to our US environment

We also have a standard vendor security questionnaire that we'd like you to start — procurement would like the questionnaire back in ~2 weeks. If it's easier, we can set up a short call with your compliance lead.

Thanks — appreciate a quick timeline so we can plan our review.

Andrew
Andrew Li
Security Engineer
Cerulean Medical
andrew.li@ceruleanmed.com

-----Original Message-----
(On behalf of procurement)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Andrew Li <andrew.li@ceruleanmed.com>
Cc: procurement@ceruleanmed.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status

Hi Andrew — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful.

Quick answers and next steps: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant (security & availability). I'm attaching a SOC 2 summary and high-level controls map; we can share the full report under an NDA if procurement requires it.
- SSO (SAML/Okta): we fully support SAML 2.0 and have a documented Okta integration. See the attached SSO configuration guide (high-level).
- SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning. I'll loop in our platform engineering lead to provide attribute mappings and endpoints.
- RBAC/admin controls: we have role-based admin controls (Org Admin, Billing Admin, App Admin) and can provide screenshots and a permissions matrix.
- Data residency/retention: hosted control plane with customer data options by region; I'll confirm retention defaults and include notes for your legal/procurement team.

I can start the vendor security questionnaire right away — please attach the file or we can use your link. To move quickly, can we do a 30-min call with your security lead tomorrow? If so, please share a few times (or feel free to add me to the questionnaire doc).

Next steps (proposed):
1) I attach a SOC 2 summary and vendor-security-questionnaire template (attached).
2) Internal handoff to our compliance/engineering for SCIM and RBAC artifacts (looping internal team now).
3) 30-min sync with your security lead to close any gaps.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Marissa / Dev — looping you both in to help respond to Cerulean's evidence request. Procurement wants the questionnaire back in ~2 weeks. Items requested:

- Full SOC 2 report (we can provide under NDA) / attached summary included
- SSO: SAML/Okta implementation guide & any certificate details
- SCIM: attribute mapping, provisioning endpoint, sample payloads
- RBAC: permissions matrix, admin UX screenshots (Org Admin, App Admin)
- Data retention/residency notes for US region

I've attached the vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx from the prospect. Can one of you own filling the questionnaire? Dev — can you confirm the SCIM endpoint and example payload? Marissa — can you pull the admin screenshots and confirm who on compliance will handle the SOC 2 NDA?

Procurement contact: procurement@ceruleanmed.com
Security contact: Andrew Li <andrew.li@ceruleanmed.com>

Thanks — tight timeline on this one.

--
Aditya
